description: An interactive ISA Allowance Planner: what's left of this tax year's ISA allowance, with a slider for what they'd pay in each month until 5 April and what would be left then - and, for someone with a Lifetime ISA, the part of it going there and the government bonus it adds. From what they recorded on the Tax page; the same sums as its Plan the Rest of This Tax Year. Use for 'how much ISA allowance have I got left', 'how much a month to use my ISA', 'what if I put £500 a month in my ISA'.

lisaMonthly.description: Of that, into a Lifetime ISA a month, in pounds, if the question gives one.

monthly.description: Into ISAs a month until 5 April, in pounds, if the question gives one. Starts at nothing.
